rationale: PyQt6-sip is the binary ABI shim PyQt6 is built against; it must never move independently of the pinned PyQt6 wheel. Dependabot #5486 proposed 13.13.0 alone and was deferred during #5499. CI locks PyQt6 6.11.x to sip 13.12.0; the owner Windows dev host stays on PyQt6 6.8.1 until MSVC runtime catches up, and any sip bump must remain compatible with that pin until a coordinated PyQt6 upgrade lands with Qt test shards green.
